findings.title: Making `.small-action` a flex container shrinks `.small-action-desc` to its content, so right-floated buttons no longer reach the right edge.
findings.body: Before this change, `.small-action-desc` was an ordinary block that took the full row width. Its buttons (`button { float: right; }`) sat at the far right of the post. With `.small-action` now `display: flex`, `.small-action-desc` becomes a flex item with no `flex-grow`, so it is only as wide as its content. For a short action like "closed this topic", the delete/edit buttons now float right inside that narrow box, next to the text instead of at the edge of the post. If any button is a direct child of `.small-action`, its float is ignored entirely, because floats have no effect on flex items. I could not see the template, so I can't tell which of the two applies. Fix: add `flex: 1 1 auto;` (or `flex-grow: 1`) to `.small-action-desc` so it fills the remaining space as it did before.
